"""Naira's draft tests for the tokenization validator.
Spec: docs/tokenization_validator.md
"""
import pytest

from larkspur.tokenization.validator import validate_tokenization_request
from larkspur.tokenization.tokens import derive_token

TEST_KEY = b"lk-test-key-0001"


def payload(**overrides):
    p = {
        "merchant_id": "mer_0042",
        "card": {
            "number": "4242424242424242",
            "exp_month": 12,
            "exp_year": 2030,
            "cvc": "123",
            "holder": {"name": "Jane Doe"},
        },
        "billing": {
            "address": {"line1": "1 Market St", "postal_code": "94105", "country": "US"}
        },
    }
    p.update(overrides)
    return p


def test_valid_payload():
    assert validate_tokenization_request(payload()).valid


def test_us_postal_code_required_nested():
    p = payload()
    del p["billing"]["address"]["postal_code"]
    assert "billing.address.postal_code" in validate_tokenization_request(p).error_paths()


def test_luhn_failure():
    p = payload()
    p["card"]["number"] = "4242424242424241"
    assert validate_tokenization_request(p).error_codes() == ["CARD_LUHN_FAILED"]


def test_pan_in_metadata_rejected():
    p = payload(metadata={"note": "card 4242 4242 4242 4242"})
    assert "PAN_IN_METADATA" in validate_tokenization_request(p).error_codes()


def test_expired_card():
    p = payload()
    p["card"]["exp_year"] = 2019
    assert validate_tokenization_request(p).error_codes() == ["CARD_EXPIRED"]


def test_token_golden_value():
    assert derive_token("4242424242424242", "mer_0042", key=TEST_KEY) == "tok_7f3a9c21e0b845d6"
